entry.title: Dionysios Anninos - 3/3 Quantum Gravity in de Sitter Space

media:group.media:title: Dionysios Anninos - 3/3 Quantum Gravity in de Sitter Space
media:group.media:description:
I plan to discuss quantum features of Lambda \gt 0 theories. An emphasis will be placed on the nature of the de Sitter horizon, Euclidean gravity methods, and the construction of theoretical toy models. Time permitting we will also discuss timelike decorations and their role in cosmology.
Dionysios Anninos (King's College London)
